data.name: Solör Bioenergy
data.description: Solör Bioenergy Group is a major Scandinavian renewable energy utility operating roughly 300 sites in Sweden and Norway, producing and distributing district heating, steam and electricity from wood fuels. At several plants (Skurup, Svedala, Munka-Ljungby, Herrljunga, Ulricehamn) it has added pyrolysis-with-carbon-capture units that co-produce biochar as a side stream. District heating remains the core business; biochar is an adjacent CDR activity.
